integrity: Universal argument uses an exact Gram inverse, barycentric face gradients, a positive all-vertex circumball certificate, and a Gram determinant. A separate rational checker verifies n=3..10; finite checks are not the proof. No independent external mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: All geometry is intrinsic to the normalized consecutive-cut metric face in full-matrix Frobenius norm; no result about the full hollow Monge simplex, alternate norms, or affine invariance is asserted. Earlier equivalent formulations remain possible.
title: Exact Euclidean centers and volume of the Monge metric face
